title: Touch Typing
coreMove: Protect the slower corrected motion long enough for it to displace the familiar wrong pattern.
sourcePressure: The source frames touch typing as habit repair: replacing an old motor pattern, tolerating frustration, and using consolidation only in service of corrected repetition.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Mistaking the temporary speed drop for failure instead of recognizing it as the cost of replacing a comfortable bad pattern.

sourceAnchors.name: touch typing
sourceAnchors.detail: the frozen support names touch typing as habit repair rather than pure beginner learning
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Touch typing hurts pride because the old pattern still works just well enough to keep stealing the keys back.

sourceAnchors.name: sleep-linked motor consolidation
sourceAnchors.detail: the source supports consolidation only as it serves corrected repetition and warns against detailed neuroscience claims
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Sleep can only strengthen what the day has actually rehearsed, so sloppy comfort is still sloppy comfort tomorrow.
